home.title: Find events and get your tickets in seconds
home.lead: BiletFlow lets anyone in Kazakhstan publish an event, register guests for free or sell tickets in tenge, and check people in at the door with a QR code.
home.forOrganizersText: Create a free event in minutes. Paid sales unlock after a short activation.

register.title: Create your account
register.done: If {email} can be used for a new account, we've sent a link to confirm it. Open the link to finish signing up.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.success: Your email is confirmed. You can sign in now.
verify.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again.
verify.resent: If that account still needs confirming, a new link is on its way.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.done: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.success: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.

required.organizer: This page is for organizer accounts.

profile.title: Organizer profile
profile.lead: Attendees see these contact details on your event pages.

payout.title: Payout account
payout.demoNotice: DEMO: no real bank account is connected and no money is paid out. Enter only the last four digits of an account number.
payout.last4Hint: Digits only. Never enter a full account number.
